newsitem.title: USA: California airports awarded $84 mln in federal grants.
newsitem.headline: California airports awarded $84 mln in federal grants.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Secretary Federico Pena on Wednesday announced more than $84 million in Federal Aviation Administration grants for improvements at California airports.
The grants, which will fund improvements at and near 31 California airports, included $9.8 million for San Francisco International and $25.5 million for Los Angeles International.

"These investments will make California airports safer," Pena said. "In addition these grants represent a strategic investment in California's infrastructure that will reap dividends in jobs, greater transportation efficiency and economic development for years to come."
Pena made the announcement at San Francisco International Airport.
